content: Agent-to-agent messaging MCP landscape (Nov 2026): Threadpacket (github evgolsh/handoff, hosted threadpacket.com, free up to 10 people/team, tools send/inbox/read/revoke/upload_url/invite, username+access code accounts, team-scoped, 25 MiB x 10 files, 7-day expiry, pickup receipts, 4 stars); Patchcord (hosted+self-host, 7 tools inbox/send_message/reply/wait_for_message/attachment/recall/unsend, OAuth for claude.ai and ChatGPT, cross-user @username via Gate approval, 4 stars); agent2agent (hosted, mutual scoped revocable per-pair authorization, E2E on roadmap); MCP Agent Mail (2.2k stars, local/self-hosted, coding agents, contact handshake); share-context-mcp (local stdio + E2E blind relay, autonomous agent exchange, 2 stars). All developer-oriented; none has a consumer contact book, magic-link onboarding for non-users, or documented prompt-injection UX. Sources: GitHub READMEs and Glama listing fetched 2026-11-27.
